mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pur_order_import_task_progress WHERE country_id=#{country} AND task_id=#{task}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pur_order_import_task_progress(country_id,task_id,lease_owner,attempt_count,phase_order,snapshot) VALUES(#{country},#{task},#{lease},#{attempt},0,'{"phase":"READING","processedRows":0,"totalRows":null,"processedImages":0,"totalImages":null,"sourceSheet":null,"sourceRow":null}') ON CONFLICT(country_id,task_id) DO UPDATE SET lease_owner=excluded.lease_owner,attempt_count=excluded.attempt_count,phase_order=0,snapshot=excluded.snapshot,updated_at=clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pur_order_import_task WHERE country_id=#{country} AND id=#{task} AND lease_owner=#{lease} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()
mapper.update: UPDATE pur_order_import_task_progress p SET snapshot=jsonb_set(#{snapshot}::jsonb,'{sourceTotalRows}',coalesce(nullif(#{snapshot}::jsonb->'sourceTotalRows','null'::jsonb),p.snapshot->'sourceTotalRows','null'::jsonb)),phase_order=#{order},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE p.country_id=#{country} AND p.task_id=#{task} AND p.lease_owner=#{lease} AND p.phase_order<=#{order} AND (p.phase_order<#{order} OR ( (p.snapshot->>'processedRows')::integer<=(#{snapshot}::jsonb->>'processedRows')::integer AND (p.snapshot->>'processedImages')::integer<=(#{snapshot}::jsonb->>'processedImages')::integer AND (p.snapshot->>'totalRows' IS NULL OR p.snapshot->>'totalRows' = #{snapshot}::jsonb->>'totalRows') AND (p.snapshot->>'totalImages' IS NULL OR p.snapshot->>'totalImages' = #{snapshot}::jsonb->>'totalImages'))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pur_order_import_task t WHERE t.country_id=p.country_id AND t.id=p.task_id AND t.status='RUNNING' AND t.lease_owner=p.lease_owner AND t.attempt_count=p.attempt_count AND t.lease_until>clock_timestamp()) AND (p.snapshot->>'sourceTotalRows' IS NULL OR #{snapshot}::jsonb->>'sourceTotalRows' IS NULL OR p.snapshot->>'sourceTotalRows' = #{snapshot}::jsonb->>'sourceTotalRows')
